# pcd_host_role (Resource)

Assigns a PCD role (e.g. `pf9-ostackhost-neutron`) to a host. Use one resource per host↔role pair. Role-specific settings are applied with their defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# host_id is the resmgr host UUID of an onboarded host.
resource "pcd_host_role" "example" {
  host_id   = "04575315-80ce-4617-9b96-6611d00c9942"
  role_name = "pf9-ostackhost-neutron"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String) The host to assign the role to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `role_name` (String) The role name (e.g. `pf9-ostackhost-neutron`). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite `<host_id>/<role_name>` ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_host_role.example <host_id>/<role_name>
```
